_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

departmentName.description: Display value of departmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_department.name

designationName.description: Display value of designationId, copied from u_mes_mast_designation.name

badgeNo.description: Number encoded on the operator badge used for station login

defaultShiftName.description: Display value of defaultShiftId, copied from u_mes_mast_shift.name

homeWorkCenterId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_workCenter._id: home work center

homeWorkCenterName.description: Display value of homeWorkCenterId, copied from u_mes_mast_workCenter.name

reportsToUserId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: reports to user

reportsToUserName.description: Display value of reportsToUserId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

dateOfJoining.description: Date of joining. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

employmentTypeName.description: Display value of employmentTypeId, copied from u_mes_mast_employmentType.name

contractorSupplierName.description: Display value of contractorSupplierId, copied from u_mes_mast_supplier.name

languageName.description: Display value of languageId, copied from u_mes_mast_language.name

lastLoginAt.description: Last login date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

passwordChangedAt.description: Password changed date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

isLocked.description: True when the record is locked

lastAccessReviewDate.description: Date of the last access review of the account (GMP-07)

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
